title: Phenotypic Heterogeneity in Hemophilia A: An Investigation of the Role of Platelet Function
brief_summary: The is study will examine whether variation in clinical bleeding frequency and severity among boys with severe Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency) is associated with variations in laboratory measurements of platelet activity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* documented circulating FVIII level of ≤1%
* age 3 - 20 years
* may be on primary or secondary prophylaxis
* granting of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* measurable inhibitor level at the time of enrollment
* ingestion of aspirin/supplement known to influence platelet function within 14 days of blood sampling, or ibuprofen within 3 days
study_population: Boys with severe Hemophilia A, Factor VIII coagulant activity less than or equal to 1%
